_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', 'We offer products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2010 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', 'We offer products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2010 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.11x; +107% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.98; conservative 2yr -34%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY08-FY10 ex-FY09 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +1.7%/yr (Q2 FY11 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 1.4-yr ex-FY09 median

BULL.desc: EPS +155.0%/yr (FY08-FY10 ex-FY09 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +155.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY10 ex-FY09, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2011-04-01) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.11x (46.9% downside to Bear $16.73 / +429.5% upside to Bull $166.90) | Adj composite 2.60 vs market 1.62: gap +0.98 [UNDERVALUED] | +107% above the EPP floor $15.21 (9x FY11E $1.69) | Conservative 2-yr case: -33.6% total (-16.8%/yr) | At 18.7x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $41.69 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; net revenue +20.6% YoY in Q1 FY11, forward revenues +5.7-8.9% (Q2 FY11 revenue guide (Q1 FY11 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
